description: 경상북도 구미시_재난 발생 정보 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경상북도 구미시. 경상북도 구미시의 연도별 사회재난 및 자연재난 발생 건수를 정리한 자료로, 「재난 및 안전관리 기본법」 제3조(정의)에 근거하여 집계되었습니다. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
